description: This file implements functions for parsing HTTP chunked transfer encoding, including initializing, resetting, iterating over chunks, extracting data between positions, and managing internal state related to chunk parsing.
external_files: libg includes and other dependencies implied by types like GError, GString, etc.

methods.name: void li_chunk_parser_init(liChunkParserCtx * ctx,liChunkQueue * cq)
methods.description: Initializes the chunk parser context and resets its state.

methods.name: void li_chunk_parser_reset(liChunkParserCtx * ctx)
methods.description: Resets the context variables to their initial state.

methods.name: liHandlerResult li_chunk_parser_prepare(liChunkParserCtx * ctx)
methods.description: Prepares the parser for processing by fetching the next chunk iterator if needed.

methods.name: liHandlerResult li_chunk_parser_next(liChunkParserCtx * ctx,char ** p,char ** pe,GError ** err)
methods.description: Advances the parser to the next chunk segment, retrieving the data to be processed.

methods.name: void li_chunk_parser_done(liChunkParserCtx * ctx,goffset len)
methods.description: Updates the parser's byte count after processing a segment.

methods.name: gboolean li_chunk_extract_to(liChunkParserMark from,liChunkParserMark to,GString * dest,GError ** err)
methods.description: Extracts data from the chunk queue between two markers into a GString.

methods.name: GString * li_chunk_extract(liChunkParserMark from,liChunkParserMark to,GError ** err)
methods.description: Extracts data from the chunk queue between two markers, returning a new GString.

ctags.name: li_chunk_extract_to
ctags.pattern: /^gboolean li_chunk_extract_to(liChunkParserMark from, liChunkParserMark to, GString *dest, GError/
